units.source_text: 十二月中旬的一天，照子和俊吉举行了婚礼。

en.t: One day in mid-December, Teruko and Shunkichi held their wedding.

units.source_text: 那天，未到中午，就飘起来雪花。

en.t: That day, before noon had come, snow began to fall.

units.source_text: 信子一个人吃完午饭，总觉得鱼的味道一直留在口中。

en.t: After eating lunch alone, Nobuko still felt as though the taste of fish lingered in her mouth.

units.source_text: “不知道东京是不是也下雪了呢？”

en.t: I wonder whether it is snowing in Tokyo too.

units.source_text: 她若有所思的仰躺在起居室的长火盆旁一动不动。

en.t: Lost in thought, she lay on her back beside the long brazier in the sitting room, without moving.

units.source_text: 雪越来越大，但是口中的鱼腥味却一直还在……

en.t: The snow fell harder and harder, but the fishy smell in her mouth was still there...
